function.arguments: {"finding": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers, specifically loyal and returning customers. This creates a severe imbalance in customer_segment between the two channels: email has 132 loyal and 134 returning customers, while paid_search has only 26 loyal and 153 returning. The raw conversion rate difference (email - paid_search) of 0.0744 is confounded by this imbalance.", "implication": "A raw comparison of conversion rates between email and paid_search is invalid because the groups are not comparable. The observed difference is not due to the campaign effect, but due to selection bias. To estimate the true effect of the campaign, we must compare like-with-like: within each customer_segment. The correct approach is to compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment and then average them (weighted by segment size in the email group), or use a stratified analysis."}
function.name: note_finding
